items.markdown:
You can purchase or sign up for an **Ahrefs** subscription directly through the official [Ahrefs Plans & Pricing](https://ahrefs.com/pricing) page.[[1]](https://ahrefs.com/pricing)

### Current Ahrefs Subscription Tiers

- **Ahrefs Free** : Free tier with basic tools for verified site owners.
- **Starter** : $29/mo (great for small personal projects).
- **Lite** : $129/mo (1 user, 750 tracked keywords, 100k crawl credits).
- **Standard** : $249/mo (1 user, 2,000 tracked keywords, 500k crawl credits).
- **Advanced** : $449/mo (1 user, 5,000 tracked keywords, 1.5M crawl credits).
- **Enterprise** : Custom pricing with uncapped limits (contact sales).[[1]](https://ahrefs.com/pricing)

*(Annual billing options are typically available on their platform to save a percentage compared to month-to-month payments.)* 

Are you looking for a **specific tier** (like Lite or Standard), or would you like help deciding **which plan fits your website or agency size** best?
